authority.authority: Codex evaluator-assisted review of each immutable source against its attached original memories; not independent human review
authority.unit: accepted source receipt, including duplicate proposals before canonical-card deduplication
authority.unsupported: at least one target-specific assertion or claimed probe unsupported by attached memory; explicitly qualified hypothesis does not establish an observation
authority.spam: irrelevant observation or redundant useful claim beyond the first equivalent claim within one member
authority.recall: distinct retained supported useful corpus expectations divided by all expected useful claims; failed execution remains a miss in end-to-end recall
authority.nativeHumanReview: required native human-review check stays unscored; no simulated human identity or quality pass is published
authority.sensitivity: minor semantic reframing is identified separately from invented technology/version/vulnerability so alternate classification is visible
